findings.evidence: `theorem integral_const (c : E) : ∫ _ : α, c ∂μ = μ.real univ • c` is unconditional — upstream/mathlib/Mathlib/MeasureTheory/Integral/Bochner/Basic.lean:990; the proof already cites `Real.volume_univ` at Shear.lean:81. (Note the `a = 0` case has no in-repo caller: the only use site, Polynomiality.lean:267, passes `xi ≠ 0`.)
findings.fix: Drop the `by_cases hc` block and close the slice with `integral_const`: `∫ _ : ℝ, g (x, x) = volume.real univ • g (x, x) = 0` since `Real.volume_univ : volume univ = ∞`. One `simp [integral_const]` after `integral_prod` replaces seven lines.

This obscures why the branch holds.

findings.evidence: `abs_le : |a| ≤ b ↔ -b ≤ a ∧ a ≤ b` (to_additive of `mabs_le`, upstream/mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Order/Group/Abs.lean:62) matches `Set.mem_Icc` for `Icc (-1) 1` on the nose.
findings.fix: Lift the vanishing statement to a named `have hvanish : ∀ x ∉ Set.Icc (-1:ℝ) 1, x ^ n * gpdOfDoubleDistribution dd dt i x xi t = 0` before the `rw`, and get `1 < |x|` in one step from `abs_le` (`lt_of_not_ge fun h => hx (Set.mem_Icc.mpr (abs_le.mp h))`) instead of the sign case split.
findings.issue: The support hypothesis of `setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero` is discharged by an eight-line anonymous `by` block nested inside the `rw` argument (317-324), and that block re-derives `1 < |x|` from `x ∉ Icc (-1) 1` by splitting on the sign of `x` with `abs_of_neg`/`abs_of_pos`/`linarith` — exactly the content of `abs_le`.

findings.evidence: Polynomiality.lean:284 `have hx : x ^ n = xi ^ n * (x / xi) ^ n := by rw [← mul_pow, mul_div_cancel₀ x hxi]` and Polynomiality.lean:298, character-identical; the surrounding `ring` goals coincide up to association.

findings.evidence: `mellinMomentH M n i xi t := mellinMomentGpd M.H n i xi t` (Moments.lean:59-60) and `Model.ofDoubleDistribution … where H := gpdOfDoubleDistribution ddH dtH` (DoubleDistribution.lean:114-118); `mellinMomentH_eq_integral … := rfl` at Moments.lean:67-69 shows the file's own preference for a named unfolding lemma.
findings.fix: Add a rfl-lemma `Model.ofDoubleDistribution_H : (Model.ofDoubleDistribution ddH dtH ddE dtE).H = gpdOfDoubleDistribution ddH dtH` (the modules already use this style, e.g. `mellinMomentH_eq_integral`) and rewrite with it at the three sites.
findings.issue: `mellinMomentH_polynomial` (370), the `polynomial` field of `polynomialityAssumptionsOfDoubleDistribution` (403) and `mellinMomentH_n0_eq_at_zero_ofDoubleDistribution` (412) are closed by bare terms about `mellinMomentGpd (gpdOfDoubleDistribution ddH dtH)`; they typecheck only by unfolding `mellinMomentH` and projecting `H` out of the `Model.ofDoubleDistribution` structure literal, with no comment saying so.

summary: The proofs are mostly well factored (the pointwise binomial lemma, the integrability/integral split), but three spots hide or duplicate reasoning: a hand-rolled reimplementation of `integral_const`, a sign case split that re-proves `abs_le` inside a `rw` argument, and a pointwise rearrangement proved twice on the D-term side. One group of declarations is also closed by terms that typecheck only after unfolding the `Model` wrapper.
